capabilities.label: Health & stability
capabilities.summary: Classifies environment readiness, coordination gates, stability, and the evidence needed before dispatch.
capabilities.signal: Healthy only when the gate, heartbeat, and stability evidence agree.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Repository and generated health surfaces; not proof of authenticated host or production health.

capabilities.label: Dispatch & lane coordination
capabilities.summary: Keeps manager, worker, and project lanes bounded with explicit packets, ownership, and coordination checks.
capabilities.signal: Every action has a lane, a scope, a readiness check, and a readable handoff.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Source contracts and local coordination reports; not proof that an external worker completed a live action.

capabilities.label: Recovery & rebind
capabilities.summary: Plans fail-closed recovery for crash, loaded-turn, stale-binding, and no-restart repair boundaries.
capabilities.signal: Recovery is prepared, verified, and read back before it is treated as complete.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Recovery plans and local repair evidence; not permission to restart or mutate production services.

capabilities.label: Model policy & transport
capabilities.summary: Makes model routing, proxy exports, transport readiness, and escalation reasons inspectable.
capabilities.signal: Transport and policy are separate gates; cache presence is not loaded-tool proof.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Model catalogs, policy decisions, and local transport checks; not provider-side availability or quota proof.

capabilities.label: Objective Runner
capabilities.summary: Turns long-running objectives into durable, verifiable, and recoverable execution state.
capabilities.signal: Objectives have contracts, state, verification, and explicit stop conditions.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Local runner contracts and canary evidence; not a claim that unattended host work is safe in every environment.

capabilities.label: Release, install & rollback
capabilities.summary: Checks generated exports, release artifacts, install repair paths, and rollback evidence before handoff.
capabilities.signal: Artifact, source, runtime, authenticated, and publication evidence stay separate.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Local artifact and release checks; not public deployment or cutover acceptance.

capabilities.label: Cross-project dashboards
capabilities.summary: Summarizes readiness, reliability, operational audits, and next-best actions across project lanes.
capabilities.signal: A dashboard is a decision surface backed by source-linked evidence, not a decorative status wall.
capabilities.evidenceCeiling: Local reports and source-linked summaries; not proof of external project health without current probes.

roadmap.title: Make manager coordination durable
roadmap.outcome: Established the manager-thread workflow, project records, generated exports, release checks, and bounded dispatch surfaces.
criteria: Manager and worker responsibilities are explicit.
Generated models and wrapper surfaces are checked before handoff.
Project evidence is durable outside the chat transcript.

roadmap.title: Fail closed around wrapper and transport ambiguity
roadmap.outcome: Separated source, package, loaded-binding, model, and coordination evidence so a green local check cannot overclaim runtime health.
criteria: Readiness is blocked when required evidence is missing.
Model escalation has a concrete reason.
Stale or repeated delivery is observable.
roadmap.evidenceCeiling: Bug records, decisions, and local checks; no provider-side guarantee.

roadmap.title: Recover without hiding the loaded-turn boundary
roadmap.outcome: Added crash recovery, rebind risk, no-restart repair, and explicit separation between a prepared rescue and a proven live binding.
criteria: Loaded-turn failure remains visible instead of being masked by package health.
Production mutation remains outside the default lane.
roadmap.evidenceCeiling: Local recovery reports and source history; not production acceptance.

roadmap.title: Turn objectives into verifiable state
roadmap.outcome: Introduced the global supervisor direction, Objective Runner contracts, canaries, and no-restart hot-repair workflow.
criteria: Objectives have durable state and verification paths.
Canaries fail closed when transport or host binding is unsafe.
Hot repair does not discard queued work.

roadmap.title: Make health classifications agree with the actual source
roadmap.outcome: Aligns canonical source migration, crash classification, app-server filesystem-watch failures, and manager health reporting.
criteria: Canonical source and generated outputs agree.
A false unhealthy regression is distinguishable from a real failure.
The operator can see what is known, stale, or blocked.
roadmap.evidenceCeiling: Current repository and local-session evidence; runtime/public claims remain gated.

roadmap.title: Give the project a live, source-backed front door
roadmap.outcome: Publish the hybrid roadmap/docs surface, add richer live executor and rollout evidence when those runtimes exist, and keep local sync visible.
criteria: Local changes can regenerate the bundled snapshot.
Remote refresh is validated and falls back safely.
Every capability and roadmap claim links to its source.
roadmap.evidenceCeiling: Hosted documentation surface; not a live Codex host monitor.

withPlugin.label: With Project Manager
withPlugin.summary: A bounded, evidence-aware flow that leaves a readable trail.

withoutPlugin.label: Without the plugin
withoutPlugin.summary: A manual flow where delivery, ownership, and final state can become ambiguous.

limitations: The plugin cannot resurrect an already-loaded broken MCP binding.
Source/package health is not proof of host, authenticated, device, public, or production health.
A hosted snapshot is not a live monitor of the local Windows machine.
